documents.title: DailyMed label: Warfarin Sodium Tablets
documents._comment: Same saved warfarin evidence as DM-02 (per the matrix spec). Minimal excerpt confirmed against the live DailyMed page by Codex on 2026-08-12: subsection 7.2 (Drugs that Increase Bleeding Risk, not 7.1), naming ibuprofen among the NSAIDs in the interacting-drugs table.
documents.verified_section_excerpt: 7.2 Drugs that Increase Bleeding Risk: NSAIDs (e.g., ibuprofen) increase the risk of bleeding. Monitor patients for signs of bleeding.
